exchange.text:
**Takeaway:** AMD's operating margin turned negative in Q2 2025 because of U.S. export-control restrictions on its Instinct MI308 data center GPUs, which management said led to approximately $800 million in inventory and related charges [[C1]]. This is a management attribution published in August 2025.

**Trend across all periods shown:** Operating margin held steady in the 10–11% range from Q3 2024 through Q1 2025 [[F25]][[F26]][[F27]], then plunged to [[F28]] in Q2 2025 (period ending June 2025). It recovered immediately to [[F29]] in Q3 2025 and continued edging higher through Q2 2026 [[F30]][[F31]][[F32]]. Gross margin followed the same pattern: stable near 50% for three quarters [[F17]][[F18]][[F19]], a sharp drop to [[F20]] in Q2 2025, then a rebound to the low-to-mid 50s [[F21]][[F22]][[F23]][[F24]].

**What is strong and what is weak:** The Q2 2025 quarter is a stark outlier on both gross margin and operating margin relative to every other quarter shown. Revenue itself was not the problem—Q2 2025 revenue of [[F12]] was in line with Q4 2024 [[F10]] and only modestly above Q1 2025 [[F11]]. The margin compression, not a revenue shortfall, drove the negative operating result.

**Counterpoint:** Despite the negative operating income of [[F3]], net income was positive at [[F4]] in the same quarter, and net margin was [[F36]]—matching the net margin from Q3 2024 [[F33]]. This means below-the-line items fully offset the operating loss, so the bottom-line impact was far less severe than the operating margin alone suggests.

**What the data cannot tell:** The figures shown do not break out how much of the charge hit gross profit versus operating expenses, so we cannot pinpoint whether the margin compression was primarily a COGS effect or an opex effect. There is also no prior-year Q2 quarter shown for year-over-year comparison.

> **Unverified hypothesis (medium confidence):** The gross margin drop to [[F20]] reflects the inventory charge flowing through cost of goods sold, given that gross margin and operating margin both fell sharply in the same quarter while revenue was stable.
